Mr. Sekhar Kumar Basu, Mr. Y. Z. Dastoor, Mr. Milon Mukherjee, Mr. Sabyasachi Banerjee, Mr.
Anirban Dutta .....

This is an application under Section 401 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, praying for quashing the complaint dated 22nd November, 2010, being numbered as Case No.
2D/10 to the Court of learned First Court of The Metropolitan and Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta under Section 16(1)(a)(i) read with Sections 6 and 7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 as well as order of issuance of warrant of arrest vide order dated 12th February, 2014.

entities.text: First Court of The Metropolitan and Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is argued that the complaint filed under relevant provisions of said Act of 1954, was no longer valid in view of promulgation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Section 89 thereof laying down overriding effect of said Act of 2006 over all other food related laws.

Learned senior advocate, Mr. Basu submits to the queries of this Court that though Section 97 of said Act of 2006 is an usual repeal and savings clause but in view of said specific Section viz. Section 89, there may be a legitimate confusion as which one will control the other.
He submits that as the present petitioners have at least an arguable case on this issue, the matter may be admitted for an extensive hearing with a prayer for stay of these proceedings.
In this connection he further submits that in the complaint, the averments are lacking to rope the petitioners in the criminal case.

In view of said submissions of Mr. Basu, this application is hereby admitted directing the petitioners to issue notice to the opposite party under Speed post/Registered post with A/D intimating that the matter will appear in the monthly combined list of April, 2014 under the heading "Contested Application".
The petitioners have to file an affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.
